settings.question: Is international shipping available?
settings.answer: Absolutely! We offer worldwide shipping. Rates and delivery times vary by region, and full details are shown during checkout.

settings.question: Will I have to pay customs fees for international orders?
settings.answer:
Shipping costs are shown at checkout, but depending on where you live, your country may charge customs duties, VAT, or other fees.

These aren’t included in our prices, so we recommend checking with your local customs office before ordering.

settings.question: How long does shipping usually take?
settings.answer:
Canada & USA orders typically arrive in 1–5 business days.

International shipping can take 2–5 business days depending on your location.

A tracking number will be provided once your order ships.

settings.question: Can I sell my collection to Rookie Legends?
settings.answer: Yes. Please contact us using the form on our Contact Us page or email us at info@rookielegends.com with the details of your cards.
